newsitem.title: USA: 3Com CEO sees close alliance with Cascade.
newsitem.headline: 3Com CEO sees close alliance with Cascade.

text.p: 3Com Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Eric Benhamou said the company has been working increasingly closely with Cascade Communications since 3Com's recent acquisition of Onstream.

Still, he said there was no reason the alliance, which he said was being encouraged in their combined dealings with International Business Machines Corp, would need to result in a business combination.
"It is a natural alliance which is getting closer every day," he said after a presentation to an American Electronics Association investment conference here.
"We don't need to combine with Cascade, at least not today, to do all of these things," he said, noting Cascade was interested in 3Com's FastIP technology, for example.
Cascade develops and makes high-performance wide area network (WAN) switches enabling both private and public network operators to provide cost-effective data communications services.
